# Gene editing extends lifespan in mice

Aging shortens life in every mammal studied^1^. Here we show that editing three genes extends the lifespan of mice by a fifth, without harm to their health^2^. The result points to a shared mechanism of aging.

## Editing three genes

Mice lived 1,000 days at 37 °C and 20 % oxygen (Fig. 1 and Extended Data Fig. 1); the full data are in Extended Data Table 1.

```{r}
x <- c(1, 2, 3)
```

## Methods

Mice were housed in groups of five. Statistics are in the legend of Fig. 1.

## Data availability

Sequencing data are deposited under accession GSE000001.
